The Dindigul biryani blew our minds away; it was so perfect! Perfectly cooked chicken pieces, perfect level of spice… a few weeks later we tried ordering again but Zomato wasn’t delivering to our location. Fast forward to the days before our marriage. We found their phone number and asked Ajay to cater for our all friends party. The biryanis and the starters were an absolutely hit! People kept saying how much they loved it. Now, about the food company. Such passionate, professional people! They absolutely love cooking, packaged our order beautifully and had it delivered on time. I am travelling tomorrow and I requested them for a favour to cook Dindigul biryani for me so I can carry it home 😊 (it’s their weekend special). Ajay is very kind and sweet to do this for me. Please try their food; it’s absolutely gorgeous!

I visited Santosham recently and absolutely loved the experience. It’s a restaurant serving full South Indian vegetarian meals, with a special focus on Kerala-style cuisine.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at this restaurant located in Rcity mall ghatkopar. While having our meal, we found a cockroach in the sambar. We immediately informed the staff and returned the food. Since the same sambar was served with both the dishes we ordered, we requested a refund for both items.

However, the staff initially refused and said they would only refund one dish. We had to explain repeatedly that the contaminated sambar was part of both meals. Only after other customers started noticing the situation and questioning what was happening did the staff agree to provide a full refund.

Finding a cockroach in food is a serious hygiene issue, and the way the complaint was handled made the experience even worse. The restaurant needs to improve both its cleanliness standards and its customer service. I would not recommend this place based on my experience.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We sincerely apologize for the unpleasant experience you had at our R City Mall, Ghatkopar outlet. As a brand, we always maintain the highest quality and hygiene standards, and we are genuinely shocked and concerned to receive this feedback, as such an incident has never been reported at this outlet before. We also apologize for the inconvenience caused during the resolution of your concern. Your feedback has been shared with our management team for immediate review and corrective action. We would appreciate the opportunity to speak with you personally. Kindly feel free to contact our Operations Manager, Mr. Swapnil Borkar, at 9082576978.
Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention.

featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the worst dining experiences I have ever had in Mumbai.
The place is extremely unhygienic, and the overall environment is very poor. The entrance itself was shocking – leaking garbage bins right outside with a horrible stench. The kitchen and surrounding area looked very badly maintained, making it completely unfit for food preparation.
The food quality is terrible. We ordered Beef Roast and Chicken Curry, and both were of extremely poor quality. The beef especially was almost inedible. To make things worse, the photos shown on Google are misleading – they do not belong to this restaurant at all but are taken from somewhere else.
Another shocking fact is that with the same kitchen/location, they have listed multiple restaurants online under different names, which is highly deceptive.
Overall, this was an utterly disappointing and unhealthy experience. Definitely not recommended to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Pradeep G
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with this hotel was very disappointing.
I ordered breakfast, but they delivered a completely different item instead of what I had ordered. When I called to inform them about the mistake, they told me that the ordered item was not available, so they sent a different one without informing me. I was surprised — how can they decide on their own what a customer should eat?
After some discussion, they agreed to replace the item within 30 minutes. However, there was no response afterward. I called five times, but they did not answer the calls, and we never received the replacement.
I then contacted the owner, who assured me that he would check and confirm. He also promised a refund if the item was unavailable. I followed up with him three times regarding the refund, but there was no response.
I have been a regular customer for the past five years and never expected such behaviour from them. After multiple failed follow-ups, I decided to consider the amount as a “donation” for their so-called excellent service.
There are other good Kerala hotels near Powai — I would recommend trying those instead. Based on my recent experience, I would not suggest choosing MTK.

Satkar Hotel, located in Vikhroli West, is a fantastic pure vegetarian restaurant, conveniently situated right across from Vikhroli Railway Station. Our dining experience was quite enjoyable. Overall, I would highly recommend Satkar Hotel to anyone, especially vegetarians, as it offers a great variety of tasty and satisfying dishes.

Public Service Announcement: Do not order the Rava Onion Sada Dosa unless you have blocked your entire day and brought snacks.

I ordered one, and apparently the chef decided to start from scratch. Growing the onions, harvesting the rava, and contemplating life choices along the way.

Meanwhile, my friend ordered a masala dosa, finished it peacefully, paid the bill, went home, took a break, and came back.

Guess what? The Rava Onion Sada Dosa was still in progress.

Just when I thought the wait was over, I watched my dosa being served to someone else. And when it finally arrived, the Rava Onion Sada Dosa barely had any onions which is impressive, considering the time it took.

At this point, I wasn’t waiting for food, I was witnessing history being made. Highly recommend if you enjoy extreme patience tests.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Being from south region native I always preferred to have authentic taste in south Indian dishes. It makes me feel tastefully grounded as well as meets my food flavors expectations. Recently I came across this place which I genuinely felt stand outs with one of the worthy places to have south Indian food in. 95% of the dishes has double digit price only but their quality of food has very competitive advantage & also the authenticity they maintain is appreciable. Would like to recommend below food items which we really loved here & hosted us by BHUMI who is from management team.
.
DAHl IDLI
Big chunks of Idlis were very soft & tastes yummy in mixture of sweet dahi [curd/lassil. It tastes like brother of Dahi wada if you ever had. There was perfect balance of sweetness, spiciness, sourness & sponginess too.
RASAM WADA
I personally like Rasam rice so much so in this case they serv tangy & spicy Rasam thin gravy with two big bolls of wada [made from vigna mungo] the same lentils from which medu wada makes up of.
DILKHUSH DOSA
Will must recommend you try out this dosa which I'm damn sure as per its name It would make your
DIL KHUSH. I already had this named dosa before but here the taste hits next level which makes you remember it.
PIZZA UTHAPPAM
It's fusion of base uthappam & pizza spreads on it. You get dosa & pizza taste together in balanced flavors. Good to try once.
PINEAPPLE SHEERA
Never miss this Indian delicacy at any cost or else you would regret that you hadn't taste. Sheera was very succulent & satisfying in taste. This ending would make you feel coming worthy here.
.
You can easily see their kitchen from seating area Or outside standing area which is neat & clean.
They maintain complete hygiene while preparation of food which I really appreciate as I myself went to kitchen to take some making clips. It has limited seating tables & standing tables outside which is keep getting packed up in short intervals. You must visit this place & enjoy the authentic south Indian food. featured_reviews.review_text:
A quite and pretty dining experience!

Spice is a pretty restaurant with beautiful ambience and great service. I went there for lunch but found the menu to be very limited. So for a restaurant inside a hotel having a small menu may be fine but not otherwise, you can find even small restaurants service you ample choices. Coming to the food it was good not great, their chinese appetizer was good but the pasta was pretty basic and bland so was their complimentary mocktail. So may be my experience wasn't that great with food but hoping other things must be good cz overall their quality of food was great. One thing to point out is their portion sizes, they are huge which was a surprise cz almost all good places have slowly started to reduce theirs, so I will advice you to order seeing it for yourself.

One strange thing that happened was they first told that the order will take 25 mins which was usual for any place but then they got it in 5 mins, so I don't know what their usual speed is. But the staff was good and the service too. The place had multiple types of seating areas and its quite well spaced out as well. So its a good fine dine experience, but i will advice you to check the menu before you go, I just hope they improve/increase their menu! Also its is generally pricier considering its inside a prime hotel, but they usually have good discounts via swiggy & zomato so do check it out!

If you visit please comment and tell what you ordered and how it was, so I can think of going back!

featured_reviews.name: Ajay
featured_reviews.review_text:
Usually, I’ve had a good experience at Ibis Spice it and enjoyed both the food and drinks, which is why my recent visit was extremely disappointing.

We had booked a table through Zomato, which included 2 complimentary mocktails. The first one was served properly, but for the second, they simply poured a tiny amount into a much smaller glass instead of making a fresh drink. I understand they were complimentary, but such cheap treatment towards guests is honestly embarrassing. If complimentary drinks are an issue, it’s better to be upfront about it.

I had also ordered a Mojito, and honestly, it was one of the worst Mojitos I’ve ever had. The mint leaves were just floating around without being properly prepared, the drink itself was served almost at room temperature instead of being chilled, and there were multiple lemon seeds inside the glass. It felt very poorly made and completely ruined the experience. My stomach got upset not sure because of the food and drinks I had but I had upset stomach the next day.

The service overall was extremely poor. Every food order took around 30-40 minutes even after repeatedly reminding the staff. It genuinely felt like nobody cared about the guests or what had been ordered.

The worst part was the billing. After requesting the bill, we had to wait nearly 40 minutes despite asking multiple times. By the end, I was exhausted and frustrated. I didn’t want to create a scene, but the staff seemed completely indifferent. We finally left the restaurant around 1:20 AM.

This was honestly one of the worst dining experiences I’ve had. I even informed the manager about everything before leaving. Really disappointed and hope the management seriously works on their service.

featured_reviews.name: Pavan Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
First review
The real stars? That filter coffee—strong, frothy, like a warm hug in a tumbler, cutting through the salty richness perfectly. The payasam, sweet and milky with a cardamom whisper, was pure bliss. Routine dosa didn't disappoint.

Subsequent Review:
When mango season hits Mumbai, Banana Leaf at R City Mall knows exactly how to celebrate it. Their limited-time Mango Mania menu brings together classic South Indian flavors with the king of fruits in a way that feels both comforting and exciting.We started with the ever-reliable Aam Ras with Poori — the kind of pairing that never fails to satisfy. The aam ras was thick, naturally sweet, and bursting with the flavor of ripe mangoes. Paired with soft, fluffy pooris that puffed up perfectly, it made for a simple yet delightful beginning. The Mango Lassi that accompanied it was creamy, chilled, and had just the right balance of sweetness and tang — a refreshing glass that cooled things down instantly.But the real star of the meal was the Mango Pullissery with Neer Dosa. This traditional Kerala-style curry, made with ripe mangoes simmered in a spiced coconut-yogurt gravy (with subtle notes of tamarind and jaggery), delivered a beautiful harmony of sweet, sour, and mildly spicy flavors. The mango pieces were juicy and tender, while the gravy had that signature creamy texture and depth you expect from authentic Kerala sadhya dishes. The neer dosa — thin, lacy, and soft like a delicate crepe — proved to be the perfect companion. It soaked up the pullissery beautifully without overpowering it, letting every bite shine. The combination was so satisfying and well-balanced that by the end of it, our usual post-meal filter coffee felt completely unnecessary. The flavors lingered pleasantly, leaving us content and surprisingly full without any heaviness.The Mango Mania offerings at Banana Leaf strike a nice balance between familiar favorites (like aam ras) and more adventurous regional specials (like the pullissery). The portions were generous, the ingredients tasted fresh, and the execution stayed true to South Indian roots while highlighting the season’s best produce.If you’re a mango lover and enjoy authentic Kerala and South Indian vegetarian fare, this special menu is worth a visit while it lasts. Just come prepared — one taste of that Mango Pullissery with neer dosa, and you might skip the coffee too.
Rating: 4.5/5
Must-try: Mango Pullissery with Neer Dosa
